Section 2.15 defines 'Incremental Equivalent Debt' mechanics but imposes no independent covenant obligation or restriction itself; serves as a defined term reference point for other covenant sections.
Section 2.18 defines 'Specified Refinancing Debt' as a defined term used elsewhere in the agreement to identify qualifying refinancing obligations.
General restriction that debt exchanges are only permitted under the defined conditions specified in this section.
Borrower shall not create, assume, or permit any lien, security interest, or other encumbrance on its property except as expressly permitted by the Credit Agreement.
Borrower shall not acquire, hold, or own any capital stock of any other person, subject to stated exceptions.
Borrower may acquire and hold capital stock in direct or indirect subsidiaries, subject to compliance with other covenants.
Capital stock of subsidiaries is permitted if the subsidiary is wholly owned and meets specified conditions relating to liens, guarantees, and subordination.
Borrower shall comply with Regulations T, U and X of the Federal Reserve Board and shall not use loan proceeds in any manner that would violate the Investment Company Act of 1940.
Each Loan Party shall guarantee the Obligations of the Borrower under the Credit Agreement.
Each Loan Party shall grant security interests in its assets to secure the Obligations.
Prohibits the Company from making any material change in the nature of its line of business.
General prohibition on incurrence of Indebtedness except as permitted by the section's enumerated exceptions and baskets.
Permits Indebtedness existing as of the Closing Date as identified in Schedule 1.1(a) or otherwise incurred in compliance with the Credit Agreement.
Permits Indebtedness incurred under the Credit Agreement itself, including revolving loans, term loans, and other credit facilities.
Permits specified categories of Indebtedness subject to monetary caps or conditions defined in the section.
The borrower and its subsidiaries are prohibited from creating, incurring, or permitting liens on their assets except as permitted by the section's exceptions.
Liens are permitted to the extent expressly provided in the exceptions and baskets enumerated within this section.
Prohibits the Borrower from engaging in any fundamental change, consolidation, merger, or similar transaction without lender consent.
Prohibits the Borrower from selling, transferring, leasing, or otherwise disposing of any assets except as expressly permitted under the section.
Permits asset dispositions in the ordinary course of business and consistent with past practice.
Permits dispositions of obsolete or worn-out equipment or inventory no longer useful in the business.
Carves out from the prohibition dispositions required by legal process or court order.
Prohibits the Company from making any Restricted Payments except as expressly permitted by the section's enumerated baskets and exceptions.
Permits Restricted Payments in an amount not to exceed a specified basket or cumulative limit.
Permits Restricted Payments meeting specified financial tests or conditions.
Excepts certain payments or distributions from the definition or scope of Restricted Payments.
Permits specific enumerated categories of Restricted Payments without quantitative limits.

The provided text contains only a section heading and page number with no substantive covenant terms, conditions, ratios, or operative language.

General section governing all collateral and guaranty matters and their operative restrictions, permissions, and conditions.

Section-level container for 1.01 (Defined Terms) - synthesized to guarantee the section's own general/chapeau language is represented alongside its discovered sub-rules.
Defined terms apply equally to singular and plural forms.
References to 'herein,' 'hereto,' 'hereof' and similar words refer to the entire Loan Document, not particular provisions.
References to Exhibits, Schedules, Articles, Sections direct reader to appropriate locations within or among Loan Documents.
'Including,' 'include,' and 'includes' are examples only and imply 'without limitation.'
The term 'documents' encompasses instruments, agreements, certificates, notices, reports, financial statements and writings in any form.
References to any Person include that Person's successors and assigns.
Specifies meaning of 'from,' 'to,' 'until,' and 'through' in computing periods between dates.
Section headings are for convenience only and do not affect interpretation of the Agreement.
Establishes LCT Election mechanism allowing Borrower to elect LCT Test Date for determining basket/ratio compliance and transaction permissibility in connection with Limited Condition Transactions.
LCT Test Date is either the date a definitive agreement is entered into or an irrevocable declaration/notice is given for a Limited Condition Transaction.
For acquisitions subject to UK Takeovers and Mergers Code, LCT Test Date may alternatively be the date of a Rule 2.7 announcement of firm intention to make an offer.
Fluctuations in ratios, tests or baskets after LCT Test Date do not cause failure of compliance if they would have complied on LCT Test Date.
Exchange rate changes between LCT Test Date and consummation date are disregarded for determining Dollar-based provision compliance and Indebtedness/Lien permissibility.
Defaults or Events of Default arising between LCT Test Date and consummation are deemed not to have occurred for purposes of LCT requirement and condition compliance testing.
For LCT investments, acquisitions or repayment/refinancing, representations and warranties need only be true and correct in all material respects as of LCT Test Date.
Ratios and baskets for unrelated transactions between LCT Test Date and consummation/expiration are tested pro forma giving effect to the pending Limited Condition Transaction.
Allocation of assets to a division or series of an LLC Restricted Subsidiary is treated as a transfer of assets between Restricted Subsidiaries.
A transaction or event is 'permitted by' or 'in accordance with' the Agreement if not expressly prohibited therein.
Ratio-based exceptions for Indebtedness, Liens and transactions are calculated without giving effect to other non-ratio-based exceptions or baskets used on the same date.
For Revolving Credit Facility borrowings under ratio-based baskets, ratios use daily average borrowings over the current and preceding three quarters, not point-in-time balance.

All financial statements and financial data must be prepared in conformity with GAAP as in effect from time to time, and accounting terms must be construed in accordance with GAAP as of the agreement date.

Upon a change in GAAP or its application affecting computation of financial ratios or baskets, the Administrative Agent and Borrower shall negotiate in good faith to amend such provision to preserve original intent, subject to Required Lenders approval (or Required Revolving Lenders approval for Section 7.08 ratio), unless Borrower elects to fix GAAP as of an alternative date.

All financial statements shall be prepared and all financial covenants calculated without giving effect to any FASB ASC 825 election (or similar accounting principle) permitting fair value measurement of financial liabilities.

Establishes methodology for converting non-Dollar indebtedness to Dollars for purposes of calculating four specified financial ratios (Consolidated First Lien Net Leverage Ratio, Consolidated Secured Net Leverage Ratio, Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio, and Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio).

For testing Financial Covenants, non-Dollar indebtedness shall be converted to Dollars at the exchange rate consistent with that used to calculate consolidated net income in the most recent financial statements of the Borrower.
For any purpose other than testing Financial Covenants, non-Dollar indebtedness shall be converted to Dollars at the exchange rate as of the date of determination.

Permits the Borrower to elect to determine the Dollar amount of borrowings by first taking into account the effects of any currency Swap Contracts entered into by Restricted Group Members in respect of those borrowings.
Provides that representations, warranties, undertakings, and Default/Event of Default status shall not be deemed affected solely by fluctuations in currency exchange rates.

Letter of Credit amount at any time is deemed to be the amount available to be drawn under such Letter of Credit during the remaining life of such Letter of Credit.

If presentation of drawing documents has been made on or prior to expiration date and the L/C Issuer has not yet honored or given notice of dishonor, the amount of such Letter of Credit that is subject of such drawing shall be treated as still outstanding.
Establishes the framework for giving pro forma effect to specified events as if they occurred on the first day of the Reference Period (most recent Test Period).

Pro forma effect shall be given to incurrence, assumption, guarantee, redemption, defeasance, retirement or extinguishment of Indebtedness (excluding revolving credit unless permanently repaid and not replaced), Reserved Indebtedness Amount, and issuance/repurchase/redemption of Disqualified or Preferred Stock.

Pro forma effect shall be given to Investments, acquisitions, dispositions, Asset Dispositions, mergers, consolidations, operational changes, business expansions, and discontinued operations, with optional election to exclude discontinued operations notwithstanding GAAP classification until disposition consummated.

Pro forma effect shall be given to operational changes or restructurings made during or subsequent to Reference Period that are expected to have continuing impact and are factually supportable, including cost savings from headcount reduction and facility closures.
Pro forma effect shall be given to designation of Restricted Subsidiary as Unrestricted Subsidiary or vice versa.

Pro forma calculations shall be made in good faith by Responsible Officer and may include cost savings, operating expense reductions and synergies, subject to a 30.0% cap on aggregate adjustments (combined with certain EBITDA definition clauses) except for adjustments permitted under Regulation S-X.

For floating rate Indebtedness given pro forma effect, interest shall be calculated using the rate in effect on calculation date as if applicable for entire reference period, taking into account Swap Obligations.
Finance Lease Obligation interest shall be deemed to accrue at rate reasonably determined by Responsible Officer to be the rate of interest implicit in such obligation in accordance with GAAP.

For revolving credit facility Indebtedness on pro forma basis, interest shall be computed based on daily average borrowings over applicable fiscal quarter and preceding three quarters, not borrowings on determination date.
Optional interest rate Indebtedness shall be deemed based on the rate actually chosen, or if none, based on such optional rate as Borrower may designate.

Notwithstanding pro forma provisions, when calculating Consolidated First Lien Net Leverage Ratio, Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio, and/or Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio for Excess Cash Flow purposes, Applicable Rate determination, or actual compliance with Financial Covenants, transactions occurring subsequent to applicable four-quarter period shall not be given pro forma effect.
When calculating leverage and coverage ratios for purposes of determining applicable percentage of Excess Cash Flow under Section 2.05(b)(i), pro forma adjustment exceptions apply.

Baskets shall not be deemed exceeded if the exceedance results solely from fluctuations in LTM EBITDA and/or Total Assets for the most recently completed fiscal quarter since last calculation.

Borrower may elect to treat all or any portion of committed indebtedness as incurred on election date; if applicable leverage/interest coverage ratios are satisfied on that date, subsequent borrowings are permitted regardless of whether ratios are satisfied at actual borrowing time.

For purposes of subsequent ratio calculations, the Reserved Indebtedness Amount shall be deemed outstanding whether or not actually outstanding, for so long as commitments remain outstanding or until borrower revokes the election.

The Administrative Agent disclaims all warranty, responsibility, and liability with respect to the administration, submission, performance, or any other matter related to any interest rate used in the Agreement or any alternative, successor, or replacement rate.

The Administrative Agent has no liability regarding whether the composition or characteristics of any alternative, successor, or replacement reference rate will be similar to or produce the same value, economic equivalence, or liquidity as the existing interest rate being replaced.

The Administrative Agent and its affiliates and/or other related entities may engage in transactions that affect the calculation of any interest rate used in the Agreement or any alternative, successor or replacement rate, including in a manner adverse to the Borrower.
The Administrative Agent may select information sources or services in its reasonable discretion to ascertain any interest rate used in the Agreement or any component thereof.

The Administrative Agent shall have no liability to the Borrower, any Lender or any other person or entity for damages of any kind (including direct, indirect, special, punitive, incidental or consequential damages, costs, losses or expenses) for any error in calculation of any interest rate or component thereof provided by any information source or service.
Each Tranche A Term Lender agrees to make a single Initial Tranche A Term Loan on the Closing Date in an amount not to exceed such lender's Initial Tranche A Term Commitment.

Amounts borrowed under Section 2.01(a)(i) and subsequently repaid or prepaid may not be reborrowed, except that prepayments will be taken into account for purposes of any Prepayment-Based Incremental Facility.
After any Revolving Credit Borrowing, the Total Revolving Credit Outstandings shall not exceed the aggregate amount of Initial Revolving Credit Commitments.

To the extent that a portion of the Revolving Credit Facility has been refinanced with Specified Refinancing Debt, each Revolving Credit Borrowing shall be allocated pro rata among the Revolving Tranches.
Borrowings, conversions, and continuations of loans require irrevocable written notice by the Borrower to the Administrative Agent in the form of a Committed Loan Notice.
Each borrowing of, conversion to, or continuation of SOFR loans must be in a principal amount of at least $1,000,000 or a whole multiple of $100,000 in excess thereof.
Loans shall be required to be maintained as SOFR Loans or ABR Loans, subject to Section 3.04.

If the Borrower fails to specify a loan Type for SOFR Loans or fails to give timely notice of conversion or continuation, the applicable loans shall automatically be made as or converted to SOFR Loans with a one-month Interest Period, effective as of the last day of the then-current Interest Period.

Each Lender may, at its option, make any Loan available to the Borrower by causing any foreign or domestic branch or Affiliate of such Lender to make such Loan, provided that such exercise does not affect the Borrower's obligation to repay the Loan.

If L/C Borrowings are outstanding on the date the Committed Loan Notice is given, the proceeds of the Borrowing shall first be applied to payment in full of such L/C Borrowings, and second to the Borrower.
During the existence of an Event of Default, at the election of the Administrative Agent or the Required Lenders, no Loans may be requested as, converted to, or continued as SOFR Loans.

L/C Issuer agrees to issue standby Letters of Credit in Dollars for Restricted Group Members from Closing Date until Letter of Credit Sublimit Expiration Date, amend previously issued Letters of Credit, and honor drawings.

L/C Issuer has no obligation to issue a Letter of Credit if a governmental order, law, or directive prohibits or restricts issuance, or imposes material reserve, capital, loss, cost or expense requirements not present at Closing Date.

L/C Issuer liability to Borrower is limited to direct damages caused by gross negligence, bad faith, or willful misconduct as determined by final court judgment; indirect, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages are waived.

Each Letter of Credit shall be issued or amended upon Borrower's irrevocable Letter of Credit Application in agreed-upon English draft language, received at least 5 Business Days (or shorter as agreed) before proposed issuance date.

Until each Revolving Credit Lender funds its Revolving Credit Loan or L/C Advance to reimburse an L/C Issuer for a Letter of Credit drawing, interest on that Lender's Pro Rata Share is solely for the account of such L/C Issuer.
Each Lender and Borrower agree that the L/C Issuer has no responsibility to obtain documents beyond those expressly required or to ascertain document validity or executor authority.

Borrower shall pay a Letter of Credit fee to each Revolving Credit Lender in accordance with its Pro Rata Share equal to the Applicable Rate for SOFR Loans multiplied by the daily maximum Letter of Credit amount, computed quarterly and due January 15, April 15, July 15, and October 15.
In the event of any conflict between the terms of Section 2.03 and the terms of any Letter of Credit Application, the terms of Section 2.03 shall control.

Notwithstanding a Letter of Credit issued for a Restricted Subsidiary's account, the Borrower shall reimburse and indemnify the L/C Issuer for such Letter of Credit and any drawings as if issued solely for the Borrower and irrevocably waives any guarantor/surety defenses.

Borrower acknowledges that issuance of Letters of Credit for Restricted Subsidiaries inures to Borrower's benefit and Borrower's business derives substantial benefits from such Restricted Subsidiaries.
Borrower may voluntarily prepay Loans in whole or in part without premium or penalty, subject to notice requirements and minimum amount thresholds.
Notice of voluntary prepayment must be received by Administrative Agent not later than 3 business days before SOFR Loan prepayment or same day for ABR Loan prepayment.
Any prepayment of SOFR Loans must be in minimum principal amount of $3,000,000 or whole multiple of $1,000,000 in excess thereof.
Any prepayment of ABR Loans must be in minimum principal amount of $500,000 or whole multiple of $100,000 in excess thereof, or if less, entire principal amount outstanding.
Prepayment notice may be conditioned on occurrence or non-occurrence of specified events and may be revoked or extended if condition is not satisfied.
Borrower must pay 1.0% prepayment premium on voluntary prepayment or amendment of Initial Tranche B Term Loans causing Repricing Event within six months of Closing Date.
For any Excess Cash Flow Period, Borrower must prepay Initial Tranche B Term Loans within ten business days after financial statements delivery.
Prepayment amount equals 50% of Excess Cash Flow (reduced to 25% or 0% if Consolidated First Lien Net Leverage Ratio below specified thresholds).
ECF prepayment amount reduced by voluntary principal prepayments of senior or pari passu secured Indebtedness during the Excess Cash Flow Period.
Upon Asset Disposition or Casualty Event generating net proceeds exceeding threshold, Borrower must prepay Term Loans unless electing reinvestment option.
If Total Revolving Credit Outstandings exceed applicable Revolving Tranche commitment, Borrower must immediately prepay or Cash Collateralize the excess.
Mandatory prepayments of Term Loans applied pro rata to each Term Loan Tranche unless otherwise agreed; application order and mechanics specified.
During no Event of Default, if mandatory SOFR Loan prepayment required mid-Interest Period, Borrower may deposit amount in Cash Collateral account until period end.
Prepayment requirement waived for Net Cash Proceeds from Foreign Disposition or Foreign Casualty Event prohibited or restricted by local law or material tax consequences.
After Borrower notifies Administrative Agent of Payment Block existence, Borrower not required to monitor Payment Block or reserve cash for future repatriation.
Appropriate Lender may elect to decline mandatory prepayment under Section 2.05(b)(i) or (ii) per specified opt-out procedures; declined amounts retained by Borrower.
All prepayments must include accrued interest on SOFR Loans and Section 3.06 amounts if applicable; repayment in original loan currency required.

Borrower may terminate unused portions of Commitments under any Term Loan Tranche, Letter of Credit Sublimit, or Revolving Credit Commitments, or permanently reduce unused portions thereof upon written notice to Administrative Agent.
Notice of termination or reduction must be received by Administrative Agent three (3) Business Days (or shorter period as agreed) prior to effective date.
Any partial reduction must be in aggregate amount of $500,000 or any whole multiple of $100,000 in excess thereof.

Borrower may not terminate or reduce Revolving Credit Commitments under any Tranche if Total Revolving Credit Outstandings would exceed Revolving Credit Facility or would exceed Revolving Credit Commitments under such Tranche.
Notice of termination or reduction may state it is conditioned upon occurrence or non-occurrence of any specified event, and Borrower may revoke notice if condition is not satisfied.

Upon termination of Aggregate Commitments and payment in full of all Obligations and expiration/termination of all Letters of Credit, Agreement automatically terminates and Administrative Agent shall comply with Sections 9.01(c) and 9.11.

Aggregate Commitments under a Term Loan Tranche automatically and permanently reduce to zero on the date of initial incurrence of Term Loans under such Tranche (on Closing Date for Initial Tranche A and B, subject to delayed draw facility exceptions).

Upon incurrence of any Specified Refinancing Debt constituting revolving credit facilities by any Restricted Group Member, Revolving Credit Commitments under the refinanced Tranche automatically and permanently reduce on ratable basis by 100.0% of such refinancing Commitments.

If Letter of Credit Sublimit exceeds Revolving Credit Facility amount after any reduction or termination of Revolving Credit Commitments, Letter of Credit Sublimit automatically reduces by such excess.
Aggregate Revolving Credit Commitments with respect to any Tranche automatically and permanently reduce to zero on Maturity Date for such Tranche.
Administrative Agent shall promptly notify applicable Lenders of any termination or reduction of Commitments under any Term Loan Tranche, Letter of Credit Sublimit, or Revolving Credit Commitment.
All facility fees accrued until effective date of termination of Aggregate Commitments and unpaid shall be paid on such effective date.

Any prepayments of Revolving Credit Loans pursuant to Section 2.06 (other than per Section 2.06(b)(ii)) shall be allocated ratably among Revolving Tranches if Revolving Credit Loans have been refinanced with Specified Refinancing Debt.

Borrower shall repay Initial Tranche A Term Loans in consecutive quarterly installments at specified percentages (0.625%, 1.25%, 1.875%) of initial principal amount over tiered time periods, with final balance due at Maturity Date.
If a scheduled principal repayment date is not a Business Day, the repayment shall occur on the immediately preceding Business Day.
All Loans shall be repaid in the currency in which they were made.
SOFR Loans bear interest at Term SOFR for the Interest Period plus the Applicable Rate for SOFR Loans under the Facility.
ABR Loans bear interest at the ABR plus the Applicable Rate for ABR Loans under the Facility, calculated from the borrowing or conversion date.

During an Event of Default, the Borrower must pay interest on all overdue Obligations at the Default Rate to the fullest extent permitted by law, and accrued unpaid interest (including interest on past due interest) is due on demand.

Accrued interest on each Loan is payable in arrears on each Interest Payment Date, and accrued interest on repaid or prepaid principal is payable on the repayment/prepayment date; interest is payable before and after judgment or commencement of any Debtor Relief Law proceeding.
Interest on each Loan is payable in the currency in which the Loan was made.
All computations of interest are made in accordance with Section 2.10 of the Agreement.

Commitment fee accrues on daily amount by which aggregate Revolving Credit Commitments exceed the sum of Outstanding Revolving Credit Loans and L/C Obligations, payable quarterly in arrears on specified dates and at Maturity Date.
Borrower shall pay to Lenders, Administrative Agent, and Collateral Agent such fees as separately agreed upon in writing in specified amounts and at specified times.

Establishes the day-count conventions for interest and fee calculations: ABR Loans based on Prime Rate use actual/365(366), other fees and interest use actual/360; interest accrues on the day loan is made but not on the day of repayment, except same-day loans accrue one day's interest.
Provides that each interest rate or fee determination by the Administrative Agent is conclusive and binding absent manifest error.

Triggers a retroactive interest/fee adjustment obligation when the Borrower's Consolidated First Lien Net Leverage Ratio calculation was inaccurate and a proper calculation would have resulted in higher interest and/or fees.
Requires comparison of the inaccurate Consolidated First Lien Net Leverage Ratio to a proper calculation to determine whether additional interest and fees are owed.
Obligates the Borrower to pay to the Administrative Agent the excess of interest and fees that should have been paid over actual amounts paid upon demand or automatically in bankruptcy.

Provides that nonpayment of retroactive interest and fees shall not constitute a Default prior to five (5) Business Days after demand by the Administrative Agent, and such amounts do not accrue Default Rate interest during this period.

Credit Extensions made by each Lender are evidenced by accounts/records maintained by such Lender and entries in the Register maintained by the Administrative Agent, with such accounts/records constituting prima facie evidence of amounts, interest, and payments absent manifest error.
Failure to record Credit Extensions or any error in recording shall not limit the Borrower's obligation to pay amounts owing with respect to the Obligations.
In case of conflict between accounts and records maintained by any Lender and those of the Administrative Agent, the Administrative Agent's records shall control absent manifest error.

Upon written request of any Lender made through the Administrative Agent, the Borrower shall execute and deliver a Note payable to such Lender, which shall be recorded in the Register and shall evidence such Lender's Loans.
Each Lender and the Administrative Agent shall maintain accounts, records, and Register entries evidencing purchases and sales by such Lender of participations in Letters of Credit.

In case of conflict between accounts and records maintained by the Administrative Agent and any Lender regarding purchases and sales of Letter of Credit participations, the Administrative Agent's records shall control absent manifest error.

Entries made in good faith by the Administrative Agent in the Register and by each Lender in its accounts/records shall be prima facie evidence of the amount of principal and interest due and payable or to become due and payable from the Borrower absent manifest error.

The failure of the Administrative Agent or such Lender to make an entry, or any finding that an entry is incorrect, in the Register or accounts/records shall not limit the obligations of the Borrower under this Agreement and the other Loan Documents.

Borrower payments must be made without condition or deduction for any counterclaim, defense, recoupment or setoff.

All payments by Borrower shall be made to Administrative Agent, for account of respective Lenders, in Dollars in immediately available funds not later than 2:00 p.m. (New York City time) on specified date.
If extension of payment would cause interest or principal of SOFR Loans to be paid in next succeeding calendar month, payment shall be made on immediately preceding Business Day.
Administrative Agent may assume Lender has made share available on proposed Borrowing date if no prior notice received from Lender, and may make available corresponding amount to Borrower.

If Lender fails to make its share available, Lender shall pay Administrative Agent interest at greater of NYFRB Rate and rate reasonably determined by Administrative Agent per banking industry rules, plus reasonable administrative fees.
If Borrower pays interest due to Lender failure to fund, Borrower shall pay at ABR Loan rate applicable to the Facility.

If both Borrower and Lender pay interest to Administrative Agent for same or overlapping period, Administrative Agent shall promptly remit to Borrower the amount of interest paid by Borrower for such period.
Borrower's payment for Lender failure to fund shall be without prejudice to any claim Borrower may have against such Lender.

Administrative Agent may assume Borrower has made payment on due date if no prior notice received, and may distribute to Appropriate Lenders or L/C Issuer the amount due in reliance on such assumption.
Amount is Rescindable Amount if Borrower has not in fact made payment to Administrative Agent.
Amount is Rescindable Amount if Administrative Agent has made payment in excess of amount actually paid by Borrower.
Amount is Rescindable Amount if Administrative Agent has for any reason otherwise erroneously made such payment.
Each Lender or applicable L/C Issuer severally agrees to repay to Administrative Agent forthwith on demand the Rescindable Amount distributed to such party in Same Day Funds with interest thereon.
Clawback repayment bears interest at greater of NYFRB Rate and rate determined by Administrative Agent per banking industry rules on interbank compensation.
Notice of Administrative Agent to any Lender or Borrower regarding amount owing under Section 2.12(b) shall be conclusive absent manifest error.

If Lender funds Loan but Administrative Agent does not make available to Borrower because Article IV conditions not satisfied or waived, Administrative Agent shall return such funds to Lender on demand without interest.
Lenders' obligations to make Loans, fund L/C participations, and make Section 9.07 payments are several and not joint; failure of one Lender does not relieve other Lenders.

Nothing herein obligates any Lender to obtain funds for any Loan in any particular place or manner or constitutes representation that Lender has obtained or will obtain funds in any particular place or manner.
If insufficient funds received by Administrative Agent, funds shall be applied first toward interest and fees then due, ratably among entitled parties.

Administrative Agent may, but is not obligated to, distribute unallocated funds received to each Lender per ratable share of sum of Outstanding Loans and L/C Obligations, in repayment or prepayment of outstanding Loans.

A Lender that obtains payment in excess of its ratable share must immediately notify the Administrative Agent and purchase participations from other Lenders to equalize the excess payment pro rata.

If any portion of an excess payment is recovered from the purchasing Lender under Section 10.06 circumstances, the purchase is rescinded and other Lenders repay the purchase price plus their ratable share of interest or amounts paid by the purchasing Lender.
A Lender purchasing a participation may exercise all rights of payment including setoff with respect to such participation as if it were the direct creditor, subject to Section 10.09.
The Administrative Agent shall keep records of participations purchased under Section 2.13 and notify Lenders following any such purchases or repayments.
Section 2.13 does not apply to the application of Cash Collateral provided for in Section 2.16.

For purposes of clause (b) of the definition of 'Excluded Taxes,' a Lender that acquires a participation pursuant to Section 2.13 is treated as having acquired such participation on the earlier date(s) on which such Lender acquired the applicable interest(s) in the Commitment(s) or Loan(s).

Borrower may request increases in Commitments under Revolving Tranches, increases in Term Loan Tranches, addition of new revolving credit facilities, or addition of new term loan facilities, each with specified terms.

Cash-Capped Incremental Facility permits incurrence of the greater of $344,000,000 or 100.0% of LTM EBITDA plus General Debt Basket Reallocated Amount minus prior incurrence under this basket and related provisions.
Ratio-Based Incremental Facility permits unlimited amount of New Loan Commitments so long as Maximum Leverage Requirement is satisfied.
Any request for increase shall be in a minimum amount of the lesser of $5,000,000 (or equivalent in Alternative Currency) or the entire amount of any increase that may be requested.

Borrower must pay or reimburse Administrative Agent, other Agents, and each Lender for all reasonable documented out-of-pocket costs and expenses incurred in connection with enforcement of rights or remedies under the Agreement or Loan Documents, including during legal proceedings and workouts, with counsel fees limited to one counsel to Agents and Lenders as a whole and one local counsel per jurisdiction, plus additional counsel for conflict of interest situations with Borrower consent.
Foregoing costs and expenses shall include all reasonable search, filing, recording, title insurance, appraisal charges and fees, and other out-of-pocket expenses incurred by any Agent.

All amounts due under Section 10.04 shall be paid within 30 days after invoiced or demand, or such longer period as Administrative Agent may agree to in its reasonable discretion, except for costs and expenses incurred prior to Closing Date which shall be paid on Closing Date if invoiced at least three Business Days prior.
The agreements in Section 10.04 shall survive the termination of the Aggregate Commitments and repayment of all other Obligations.

If Borrower fails to pay when due any costs, expenses or other amounts payable hereunder or under any Loan Document, such amount may be paid on behalf of the Borrower by the Administrative Agent after applicable grace periods have expired, in its sole discretion, and Borrower shall immediately reimburse the Administrative Agent.
Section 10.04 shall not apply with respect to Taxes other than any Taxes arising from any non-Tax cost or expense.

Indemnity does not apply to the extent liabilities resulted from bad faith, gross negligence or willful misconduct of the Indemnitee or its Affiliates/controlling persons as determined by final court judgment.
Indemnity does not apply to the extent liabilities resulted from material breach of Loan Documents by the Arranger, Agent-Related Person, Lender, or L/C Issuer as determined by final court judgment.

Indemnity does not apply to disputes among Indemnitees (other than disputes involving Administrative Agent, Arranger, other Agents or L/C Issuers in their capacities) that did not involve Borrower or Subsidiary actions or omissions.

Waiver of special, punitive, indirect or consequential damages does not limit the indemnification obligations of Loan Parties under Section 10.05.

Indemnity applies whether or not investigation, litigation or proceeding is brought by or against any Loan Party, its directors, shareholders or creditors, an Indemnitee or other Person, and whether or not Indemnitee is otherwise a party thereto.
Amounts due under Section 10.05 shall be payable within 30 days (or such longer period as any Agent may agree to in its reasonable discretion) after demand and receipt of reasonably detailed invoice.

Each Indemnitee is obligated to refund or return any amounts paid by any Loan Party under this paragraph to the extent such Indemnitee is not entitled to payment in accordance with the terms hereof as determined in a final, non-appealable judgment.

Upon invalidation, fraud, preference, or set-aside of any payment or setoff to Agents, L/C Issuers, or Lenders, the original obligation revives and continues in full force and effect as if the payment had not been made.
Each Lender and L/C Issuer severally agrees to pay to the Administrative Agent its applicable share of any amount recovered from or repaid by any Agent, plus interest at the NYFRB Rate.
The obligations of Lenders and L/C Issuers under clause (b) survive payment in full of the Obligations and termination of the Agreement.

Permits disclosure with the written consent of the Borrower.
